summary: Executable fixtures assert argument digests are order-independent, read reuse is keyed by attempt and never collides across tools or arguments, capability resolution pins to the task revision and yields no grants for a missing revision, approval policy distinguishes restricted from unrestricted without widening scope, and tool draining rejects ungranted tools, pauses consequential tools, refuses repeated applied writes, reuses only same-attempt reads, and emits one message per outcome.
